note: Provenance record for the local LLM runtime added in the chart/open-ended-chat upgrade. This is a later host-side addition and is unrelated to the frozen full20_final_001 RV32IM/TFLM experiment, which this runtime never touches.

build_config.llama_curl: OFF (model downloaded independently via curl, not llama.cpp's built-in fetcher)

runtime.built_on_host: this project's Linux EDA server (Rocky Linux 9.8, glibc 2.34, Intel Xeon Gold 6152)

model.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
model.multilingual: Qwen2.5 is documented as supporting 29+ languages including English and Spanish
chosen_because: well under the 3 GiB download cap (1.04 GiB)
official quantization published by the model's own publisher (Qwen), not a third party
small enough for fast CPU-only inference on a shared server with a conservative 4-thread cap

launch_config.note: No GPU was detected on this host (nvidia-smi absent); n-gpu-layers=0 is therefore not a restriction but a reflection of actual hardware. Per task instruction, GPU would only be used if allocated/available.

measured_at_smoke_test.note: First measurement: a single short direct curl request to /v1/chat/completions, not a mocked adapter test.

measured_during_full_e2e_session.method: 13-turn real HTTP session against the running Flask app (apps/results_chat/tests/test_live_llm.py plus a dedicated end-to-end script), covering open-ended RAG questions, Spanish paraphrases, FAQ rephrasing, and chart requests in the same session
measured_during_full_e2e_session.chart_requests_seconds: all < 0.21s (deterministic, no LLM call for chart captions)
measured_during_full_e2e_session.note: RSS grew from ~1.84GB (idle/single short request) to ~2.2GB over a sustained multi-turn session (ctx-size=4096 KV cache), still well within the host's available RAM (94 GiB free at session start). Open-ended RAG latency (~12-24s) is dominated by the long grounding system prompt plus up to 320 generated tokens on a 4-thread CPU budget; the FAQ-rephrase path is faster since its prompt is shorter. See apps/results_chat/README.md 'Measured latency and memory' for the full discussion and the tuning (max_tokens 500->320, retrieved chunks 4->3, history window 8->2 turns for this path) applied after the first, slower measurement.
